query:
update ledger_entries
         set title = $2, note = $3, category = $4, occurred_on = $5, amount = $6, currency = $7,
             item = $8, base_amount = $9, rate = $10, rate_date = $11, details = $12,
             version = version + 1, updated_by = $13, updated_at = now()
         where id = $1
